This section tracks active research gaps. It is not a findings page.

## Current priorities

The commissioning issue named five documents or record classes. **Four copies are still sought** and remain on [Wanted Sources](wanted-sources.qmd): Creekview 202 evaluation, *Keys on Freedom*, ECPM manual(s), and original ministry CSIL pilot/design records.

The November 2008 CSIL program-review synthesis is **no longer copy-sought**. A Microlog fiche is inspectable on Internet Archive; see the [2008 catalogue record](../sources/2008-program-review-synthesis.qmd).

A September 2026 public-source pass added inspected catalogue records for contemporaneous and later public evidence (Hansard 1984 and 1986; Mattinson & Rompf 1987 abstract; Haw 1989; Roeher bibliography; Ombudsperson 2012; SCI BC and IFRC pages; current ministry and VCH CSIL policy). *Keys on Freedom* still lacks independent bibliographic confirmation. The 1995 HEU *Guardian* PDF was retrieved as a scan; the page-9 CSIL passage was read from the image.

Cited history chapters now cover [Creekview](../history/creekview.qmd) (also origins/context), [ECPM](../history/ecpm.qmd), [CSIL design and pilot](../history/csil-pilot.qmd), and [later evolution](../history/evolution.qmd). Copies still sought are listed on [Wanted Sources](wanted-sources.qmd). The 1987 Creekview evaluation report remains wanted. A [state of the evidence](../history/index.qmd#state-of-the-evidence) summary sits on the History index.

## How to use this section

- Add a wanted-source record when a document is known or strongly attested but not in hand.
- Keep status labels honest (`known-to-exist-copy-sought`, `physical-copy-known`, `permission-required`, and so on).
- Do not convert a gap list into narrative history.
